column7: Typo – Please note that the general usage is without the hyphen. Therefore, please consider this to be a Global Correction across all dictionaries. Definitions should be spelled according to current standards. Consider this: "In Sanskrit, do we use a hyphen if it is not needed?" Same in English!
Typo – You may consider to make this a Global Correction using the target search: "°ddaś"  ——becomes—–  "°dṛś" ; There is no other possible correct combination of these letters.

Typo – Please note that the root is considered as: "√ṣic" ,  which means the Desid. form should only be: "sisikṣati". I find no indication of a variation of the root purely as: "√sic" , and I find no evidence of this form in usage: ""sisikṣati". I hope that Andhrabharati will look into the form: "siṣikṣati" , and either confirm or deny its correctness.
